decision: Use the 2024 survey only as a conflict-detection lead. Its internal richness statements do not reconcile, its team substantially overlaps the 2025 survey team, and its item-specific reuse terms were not verified. Do not use either table to independently validate identities or publish species claims.

source.title: Ichthyofaunal Diversity and Water Quality Parameters in Talisay and Bagac River Systems, Bataan, Luzon Island, Philippines
source.citation: Corpuz, M. N. C., Nacorda, H. M. E., Casal, C. M. E., Faustino-Eslava, D. V., Jaranilla-Sanchez, P. A., Vedra, S. A., Paguia, H. M., & Espaldon, M. V. O. (2024). Biodiversity Journal, 15(3), 649-658. DOI: 10.31396/Biodiv.Jour.2024.15.3.649.658.
source.methodSummary: The paper describes nine longitudinal stations per river, three 70 m stream sections per station, backpack electrofishing plus seine/cast nets, and identification to the lowest possible taxon. It says some specimens were retained live or preserved for further documentation and identification.
source.localityLimits: The paper gives river-mouth coordinates and broad upstream/midstream/downstream descriptions, but no collection coordinate or station-to-reach crosswalk for the reported taxon rows. Do not map table entries to the mouth coordinates or infer a verified reach geometry.

authorOverlapWith2025.interpretation: Substantial research-team overlap; this is a separate sampling period, but not independent taxonomic corroboration by a separate expert team.

reuseReview.decision: Do not redistribute the species table or use it as an app data source until item-specific reuse terms are confirmed. This review stores only bibliographic and quality-control findings.

withinSourceConflicts.decision: Conflicting values; no per-river richness value is adopted.
